Hi Samir — thanks, and welcome. Quick checklist below so finance can complete the vendor setup without delays. Please reply here or upload to the portal link at the end.

Required items for Redwood finance (minimum):
- Bank proof: bank letter on bank letterhead OR bank-issued verification PDF + scanned voided check. (We accept bank letter or bank portal PDF; bank statement alone is usually not enough unless it contains bank contact info.)
- Tax proof: completed W-9 (US entities) or W-8/W-8BEN-E as appropriate.
- Legal name and EIN/Tax ID.
- Payment rails: for wires provide account name, account number, ABA routing, SWIFT/BIC (if international). For ACH provide routing + account.
- Remittance sample: we prefer ISO-20022 (pain.001) XML for automated ingestion. If you only produce CSV, include a header mapping doc and an example with PO references.
- PO mapping guidance: we require each invoice to include a PO number in the invoice.external_id field (or a dedicated PO column on CSV). If you plan to send line-level remittance, please include the invoice line IDs and PO item references; otherwise a summary-level remittance that references the invoice and PO is OK.

Security/transfer of docs: please upload sensitive docs to your vendor portal or send via an encrypted SFTP/DocuSign envelope to the secure link below. Avoid sending bank account numbers unencrypted over email.

Attachments (attached to this thread): vendor_onboarding_checklist.pdf (checklist + how we map fields into our AP system).

Next steps:
1) Upload bank letter + W-9 to the portal link below.
2) If you can, attach the pain.001 sample (we'll validate format against our parser).
3) Ben, Marissa — would you like to run a quick validation call Tuesday morning?

Portal link for secure uploads: https://vendor-portal.fundrails.com/invite/6f3a2b

Thanks Samir — I received the attachments and validated the bank letter header with our payments processor. A couple quick items before we finalize: 

1) Please use the secure DocuSign envelope for sensitive docs (I sent a request to samir@fundrails.com). If you already uploaded to the portal, mark the upload ID in the portal so we can fetch it.
2) Micro-deposits: send them to the test account we provisioned (test ACCT ID: REDW-VND-1182). We will confirm amounts and reply to this thread when verified.
3) Remittance mapping: Redwood's AP system accepts pain.001 but requires the following fields in the CreditTransferTransaction: EndToEndId (invoice id), InstdAmt (amount), RmtInf/Ustrd (PO# or PO line refs). The sample you sent looks good but the parser flagged a missing EndToEndId on one summary batch — can you add invoice-level EndToEndId values?
4) PO guidance: for automatic matching we require either PO number on the invoice or a PO reference in the remittance (RmtInf). Summary remittances are OK but line-level is preferred for multiple PO invoices in a single payment.

Action items for FundRails:
- Re-send updated pain.001 with EndToEndId populated for invoices (small edit).
- Upload DocuSign-signed bank letter OR mark portal upload ID so we can pull the document.
- Confirm micro-deposit timestamps (we expect them within 24 hours).

If everyone is agreeable, I'll mark the vendor status as "Pending Payments Validation" and schedule the validation window for 6/4 10:00am PT to confirm micro-deposits and run a parser validation. Samir — can you confirm availability?

Thanks,
